verdict.rationale: The firm has a dedicated Trademarks, Copyrights, Trade Secrets & Advertising practice managing national/global trademark portfolios for clients ranging from startups to multinationals, which covers clearance, registration, and portfolio management. However, evidence does not explicitly detail a distinct "brand enforcement" service (e.g., opposition/cancellation proceedings, litigation against infringers) beyond general trademark management language. Missing for 10: explicit mention of enforcement litigation/opposition work, dedicated team bios/headcount for trademark practice, independent verification or case examples of enforcement actions.
